description: Renders every view of a checked C4 file to SVG, and to JPEG or PNG with a headless Chrome or Edge when one is installed, beside the file and into the run's artifacts with a copy of the .c4 itself. The same renderer the viewer uses, so the images match the screen. No model call.
icon: <rect x="3.5" y="5" width="17" height="14" rx="2.5"/><path d="M7 15l3.5-4 2.5 3 2-2.2L17 15" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>

params.label: Formats (svg, jpeg, png; comma separated; blank = the setup answer, else svg,jpeg)
Views to render (ids, comma separated; blank = the setup answer, else all)
Save images in the checkout (true, false; blank = the setup answer)
Output folder (relative to the C4 file; blank = <name>.renders)
